You're not particularly interested in the hows and whys and histories of art (and thus don't have any Background- granted insight into Art Lore) and have grown increasingly fond of “redistributing” art you collect. The idea of all the artwork doubtless tucked away in the old ruin gathering dust and admired by none is a compelling-in-itself reason to go with her—nobles like the Arudoras always collect art, and Bastardhall's been abandoned for so long that who knows what treasures await liberation within?
